content: Flyway is recommended over Liquibase for simplicity: plain versioned SQL migration files, convention over configuration, near-zero learning curve, ideal for a single-database-per-service Postgres setup. Liquibase (XML/YAML/JSON changelogs with rollback support) is better suited to database-agnostic, multi-vendor or complex enterprise release pipelines -- unnecessary complexity for a portfolio project with one Postgres schema per service.
